lines.en: I step out into the living room after deciding to spend the morning with Ami.
lines.zh: 我走进客厅,决定这个上午陪 Ami 过。

lines.en: I feel like it’s been quite a while since the two of us have done anything other than just lounge around the house together, so maybe she’ll actually want to get out today?
lines.zh: 感觉我们俩已经好久没一起宅在家里干点别的了,所以她今天说不定真的想出门?

lines.en: There’s only so much I can take of being stuck inside the house with a cute girl who will cook and clean for me and-
lines.zh: 跟一个愿意给我做饭打扫的可爱女孩关在同一间屋里,我能忍的也就那么多——

lines.en: Wait, why am I complaining again?
lines.zh: 等等,我刚才在抱怨什么来着?

lines.en: : Good morning, [amimaster]. Are you done narrating your thoughts inside of your head and ready to pay attention to me?
lines.zh: : 早安,[amimaster]。脑内独白完毕了吗?准备好注意我了吗?

lines.en: : I guess so.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Did you sleep well?
lines.zh: : 睡得好吗?

lines.en: : Well enough. How about you?
lines.zh: : 还行。你呢?

lines.en: : Really good, actually! And I’m glad you’re finally up because I was just thinking that it’s been a while since the two of us did anything fun together.
lines.zh: : 超好!而且你终于起床了真好,因为我刚在想,我们俩好久没一起干点有趣的事了。

lines.en: : Ami, are you able to read my mind? Because this is starting to get weird.
lines.zh: : Ami,你会读心术?这开始有点吓人了。

lines.en: : Yup! I'm a mind reader. And right now, you're thinking that you want to take me shopping.
lines.zh: : 没错!我会读心。你现在就在想,你想带我去逛街。

lines.en: : On second thought, why don't I just sit on the couch and have you cater to me for the rest of the day?
lines.zh: : 仔细想了想,还不如我坐在沙发上,让你伺候我一整天。

lines.en: : That’s what I always do, though!
lines.zh: : 我平时不就是这么干的嘛!

lines.en: : And you're very good at it.
lines.zh: : 而且你干得非常出色。

lines.en: : Flattery will get you nowhere, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 恭维话对你没用,[amimaster]。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. We both know that's not true.
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托。这话连你自己都不信。

lines.en: : Are we really not going to do anything today?
lines.zh: : 我们今天真的什么都不干吗?

lines.en: : What exactly do you even need to go shopping for?
lines.zh: : 你逛街到底需要买什么?

lines.en: : Please explain to me in detail why I must use my hard-earned money on things that you require.
lines.zh: : 请详细解释一下,为什么我必须把我辛苦挣来的钱,花在你需要的东西上。

lines.en: : Because...you’re my legal guardian and I don’t have a job?
lines.zh: : 因为……你是我的法定监护人,而我又没有工作?

lines.en: : I can’t just stay in the same clothes forever, you know.
lines.zh: : 我总不能一辈子穿同一套衣服吧。

lines.en: : Well, it hasn’t seemed like a problem so far.
lines.zh: : 嗯,到目前为止这好像都不是个问题。

lines.en: : It’s a huge problem! A colossal one!
lines.zh: : 这是大问题!天大的问题!

lines.en: : How am I supposed to know you love me if you never pamper me?!
lines.zh: : 你要是从不宠我,我怎么知道你爱我?!

lines.en: : And also, your money isn’t hard-earned at all! You never even do anything!
lines.zh: : 而且你的钱根本不是辛苦挣来的!你明明什么都没干!

lines.en: : You’re the worst teacher ever!
lines.zh: : 你是史上最烂的老师!

lines.en: : Are you throwing a temper tantrum right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在耍小性子吗?

lines.en: : Are YOU throwing a temper tantrum right now?!
lines.zh: : 你才是在耍小性子呢?!

lines.en: : I just want to eat breakfast.
lines.zh: : 我只是想吃个早餐。

lines.en: : No. You just want to hate me and take advantage of my undying love for you.
lines.zh: : 不。你只是想讨厌我,还想利用我对你至死不渝的爱。

lines.en: : I'm not taking advantage of you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我没有利用你,Ami。

lines.en: : You only like me because I’m a good cook and I do your laundry.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢我,只是因为我做饭好吃、还会给你洗衣服。

lines.en: : And also because I touch your penis sometimes.
lines.zh: : 还有我偶尔摸摸你的 penis。

lines.en: : Well...I mean, that’s not entirely inaccurate.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧,这倒不算全错。

lines.en: : So, what better way to make it up to me than by taking me to the mall and letting me look at a few things?
lines.zh: : 那,有什么比带我去商场、让我随便看几样东西更好的补偿方式呢?

lines.en: : We don’t actually need to buy anything.
lines.zh: : 我们其实不用真买什么。

lines.en: : I can just stare at all of the cute clothes I could be wearing if my [uncle] actually cared about me.
lines.zh: : 我只要盯着那些可爱衣服看看就好——看看如果我 [uncle] 真在乎我,我本可以穿什么。

lines.en: : Can you at least make breakfast first?
lines.zh: : 你至少先把早饭做了行吗?

lines.en: : Yes, but only if you promise to go with me right now and not wait until after you're done eating to change your mind.
lines.zh: : 可以,但你得保证现在就答应陪我,不许等吃完饭再反悔。

lines.en: : Stop being so perceptive. I don't like it.
lines.zh: : 别那么洞察人心。我不喜欢。

lines.en: : Yay! You didn't say no, which means that you're okay with it!
lines.zh: : 耶!你没说不行,说明你答应了!

lines.en: : Those words would not hold up in court, you know.
lines.zh: : 这套说辞在法庭上可站不住脚,你知道吧。

lines.en: : Sure they would! Now go get dressed while I make you breakfast.
lines.zh: : 站得住!快去换衣服,我给你做早餐。

lines.en: : Ugh, fine. I’ve already accepted that I’m not going to be able to talk you out of this anyway.
lines.zh: : 唉,好吧。反正我也认了,反正劝不动你。

lines.en: I head back into my bedroom and put on the same outfit I put on every day, wondering if maybe I should splurge on some new clothes as well.
lines.zh: 我回卧室换上每天那套衣服,琢磨着自己是不是也该挥霍一下,买点新衣服。

lines.en: I ultimately decide against it, though, because if either one of us is going to actually benefit from some new clothes it's Ami.
lines.zh: 不过最终还是打消了这个念头——要说新衣服能带来好处的那个人,也该是 Ami。

lines.en: Say what you want about the lack of variety in my wardrobe, but I am a young-ish adult male who has already won over a multitude of girls without having to do much-
lines.zh: 想怎么吐槽我衣柜单调都随你,但我是个还年轻的成年男性,没费什么劲就赢取了一大批女孩——

lines.en: And Ami is one of those girls, who I'm sure wants to look even prettier for a better chance at coming out of love-gauntlet in first place.
lines.zh: 而 Ami 就是其中一个,我敢肯定她只是想变得更漂亮一点,好在这场恋爱试炼场里抢下第一名。

lines.en: Unfortunately, things like that don't come without a cost. And in this case, that cost is going to be my money.
lines.zh: 可惜,这种事没有免费的。而这次的代价,就是我的钱包。

lines.en: Unless...I use today to convince her that it might be time to get a job of her own.
lines.zh: 除非……我借今天说服她:也许是时候找份自己的工作了。

lines.en: I remember her telling me in the past that she had a secret source of income, but I subsequently found out that source of income was one of my credit cards when the bill showed up in the mail.
lines.zh: 我记得她以前跟我说过,她有个秘密收入来源。但后来账单寄到家里,我才发现那个来源是我的一张信用卡。

lines.en: That source of funding has been cut off, leaving her with nothing to her name except the clothes on her back and the various manga she acquired through low level identity theft.
lines.zh: 那个资金来源已经切断,如今她名下一无所有,只有身上的衣服,和靠低级身份盗窃搞来的各种漫画。

lines.en: The only issue I can think of when it comes to her getting a job is the whole part where she'd need to separate from me.
lines.zh: 说到她找工作,我唯一想到的问题,就是她得离开我身边这一整件事。

lines.en: So I'll just have to figure out how to spin things in a way that makes it sound like this would be good for both of us.
lines.zh: 所以我得想个说法,把这事包装成对双方都好。

lines.en: If I'm able to do that, then-
lines.zh: 要是能办到,那么——

lines.en: : Sensei! Are you ready yet? Or are you thinking stuff again?
lines.zh: : Sensei!你准备好了吗?还是在想事情?

lines.en: : I am always thinking stuff. That is what it means to have a brain.
lines.zh: : 我永远在想事情。有大脑就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Well, use your brain to finish putting your clothes on because breakfast is ready and I want clothes!
lines.zh: : 那就用你的大脑把衣服穿完,早餐好了,我想要衣服!

lines.en: I sigh to myself while sliding off my shirt, wondering if a day will ever come where I need to start doing things for myself.
lines.zh: 我一边套上上衣一边叹气,想着有一天我会不会也必须开始自己的事情自己做。

lines.en: I hope not.
lines.zh: 希望不是。

lines.en: That would suck.
lines.zh: 那就太惨了。

lines.en: Ami hangs her arm over the railing, overlooking a surprisingly low amount of people for a weekend morning.
lines.zh: Ami 手臂搭在栏杆上,俯瞰着人群——周末的早上,人少得出奇。

lines.en: She smiles as I take my place next to her, but doesn’t pay much attention to me right away.
lines.zh: 我在她身边站定时她笑了笑,却没马上理会我。

lines.en: : You know I was only half-messing around with you this morning, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我今天早上一半是闹着玩的,对吧?

lines.en: : I know you would have caved and brought me here anyway if all I did was ask nicely.
lines.zh: : 我知道只要我好好开口,你反正会乖乖带我来。

lines.en: : Sure, you might be a freeloader who never really does anything around the house, but you care about me and buy me food and that’s all that matters.
lines.zh: : 没错,你或许是个在家什么都不干的白吃白住党,但你在乎我、给我买吃的,这就够了。

lines.en: : I have no idea whether that's a compliment or an insult.
lines.zh: : 我分不清这是夸还是损。

lines.en: : Can it not be both?
lines.zh: : 不能两样都是吗?

lines.en: : I kind of like how lazy you are. It gives me more excuses to spend time with you and validates my purpose in this world as a caring and attentive [niece].
lines.zh: : 我还挺喜欢你这副懒样的。这给了我更多黏着你的借口,也印证了我作为一只贴心周到 [niece] 的存在意义。

lines.en: : That’s right, Ami. Which is why I’ve decided to do something very special for you today.
lines.zh: : 说得对,Ami。所以我今天决定为你做一件特别的事。

lines.en: : Special? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 特别?什么意思?

lines.en: I reach into my pocket and pull out a wrinkled 1,000 Yen note and hold it out toward her.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里摸出一张皱巴巴的一千日元纸币,朝她递过去。

lines.en: : This is yours. Don’t spend it all in one place.
lines.zh: : 这是你的了。别一次花完。

lines.en: : Wow! Sensei! I didn’t think you’d actually-
lines.zh: : 哇!Sensei!没想到你还真会——

lines.en: : Hey, wait a second! That's only 1,000! What the heck am I supposed to buy with that?!
lines.zh: : 喂,等一下!这才一千!这点钱我能买什么?!

lines.en: : I can’t even get a skirt with that much!
lines.zh: : 连条裙子都买不起!

lines.en: : You can buy socks. Those are cheap, right?
lines.zh: : 可以买袜子啊。袜子很便宜的,对吧?

lines.en: : I don’t need socks! I have a million socks!
lines.zh: : 谁要袜子!我的袜子多到堆成山!

lines.en: : This is literally all I have on me.
lines.zh: : 我身上真的就这些了。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh! I know from past experience that you have a credit card.
lines.zh: : 骗人!凭过往经验,我知道你有信用卡。

lines.en: : What happened to the whole “You don’t need to actually buy me anything” bit from earlier? Can we go back to that?
lines.zh: : 那句「其实不用真给我买东西」呢?我们能回到那个版本吗?

lines.en: : I was obviously just being polite when I said that. You need to get me at least something.
lines.zh: : 那显然是客气话。你至少得给我买点什么。

lines.en: : Why don’t you just get a job if you’re so concerned about money?
lines.zh: : 既然这么在意钱,你干脆自己找份工作不就完了?

lines.en: : Umm...Aren’t you my job?
lines.zh: : 呃……你不就是我的工作吗?

lines.en: : I guess I kind of am. But why not get a second one, then?
lines.zh: : 好像也算。那再兼职一份怎么样?

lines.en: : Hmm...
Ami looks over the railing as a trace of concern spreads across her face.
lines.zh: Ami 望向栏杆外,一丝忧虑爬上她的脸。

lines.en: If I know her well enough (Which I’m pretty sure I do), she’s probably thinking about whether or not it’s worth sacrificing her time with me in exchange for material goods.
lines.zh: 如果我足够了解她(我相当确定我了解),她大概在纠结:牺牲跟我相处的时间,换一些物质的东西,值不值。

lines.en: And if I know her even better than that (Which I’m pretty sure I do), I expect her to come out and say that she’d rather stay with me than-
lines.zh: 而如果我比那更了解她(我相当确定我了解),我预计她会亲口说出「比起那些,我宁愿陪着你」之类的——

lines.en: : What kind of job do you think I should look for?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我该找什么样的工作?

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等,什么?

lines.en: : What? You said I should get a second job, so the least you can do is help me think of one.
lines.zh: : 怎么?是你说让我再找份工作的,那你至少得帮我参谋。

lines.en: : I thought your love for me was going to trump your desire for material goods. That's how this played out in my head.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你会让我在你和对物质的渴望之间,选择爱情呢。我脑内的剧本是这么演的。

lines.en: : Obviously, my love for you will always come first.
lines.zh: : 显然,我对你的爱永远排在第一位。

lines.en: : But I’m still a girl who wants cute stuff and tickets to concerts and blah blah blah and you won’t give me more than 1,000 Yen because you hate me.
lines.zh: : 但我毕竟是个想要可爱玩意、想要演唱会门票、想要诸如此类的女孩,而你只肯给我一千日元,因为你讨厌我。

lines.en: : I don’t hate you, I just...don’t know the standard cost of clothing for a girl your age.
lines.zh: : 我不讨厌你,我只是……不知道你这个年纪的女孩买衣服的标准价位。

lines.en: : You’d think that years of buying clothes for a girl my age would have ingrained that into your memory by now.
lines.zh: : 你给这个年纪的女孩买了这么多年衣服,这数字居然还没刻进你的脑子里。

lines.en: : Ami, if you get a second job, who is going to make me breakfast in the morning?
lines.zh: : Ami,你要是真去兼职,那谁早上给我做早饭?

lines.en: : Who said I’m going to work mornings?
lines.zh: : 谁说我要上早班?

lines.en: : You can’t go making my schedule for me when I don’t even have a job yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没找到工作呢,你就先把我的排班表定好了?

lines.en: : Especially when we don’t even know what my job is going to be.
lines.zh: : 更何况,我们都还不知道我的工作会是什么。

lines.en: A job for Ami, huh?...
lines.zh: 给 Ami 找工作啊……

lines.en: There is one thing that pops into my mind, but I’m not really sure if she’d go for it or not.
lines.zh: 有一件事浮现在我脑海,但我真不确定她愿不愿意。

lines.en: In fact, the only reason it popped into my mind at all is that I kind of just want to see how she’d look in the uniform.
lines.zh: 说实话,它能浮现在我脑海的唯一理由,是我有点想看她穿上那身制服的样子。

lines.en: : What about a maid cafe?
lines.zh: : 女仆咖啡厅怎么样?

lines.en: : There’s one nearby, isn’t there?
lines.zh: : 附近不就有一家?

lines.en: : There is but...why do you know about it?
lines.zh: : 是有……可你怎么会知道那家店?

lines.en: : That place is still kind of new and I thought Maya, Ayane and me were the only ones who went there.
lines.zh: : 那家店还挺新的,我一直以为只有我、Maya 和 Ayane 去过。

lines.en: What I can’t tell Ami is that Maya is the reason I know about it.
lines.zh: 我不能告诉 Ami 的是,我之所以知道那家店,是因为 Maya。

lines.en: I’ll just let her assume it was Ayane that told me or something.
lines.zh: 就让她以为是 Ayane 告诉我的好了。

lines.en: : How I know about it doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道的不重要。

lines.en: : Hey, hold on a second, dearest [uncle].
lines.zh: : 喂,等等,我最亲爱的 [uncle]。

lines.en: : You disappear for most of the day on weekends and I never really ask where you go.
lines.zh: : 你周末一整天大部分时间都不见人影,我也从来不问你去哪。

lines.en: : Combine that with how you don’t want to give me money and...
lines.zh: : 再加上你又不愿意给我钱,然后……

lines.en: : ...And what?
lines.zh: : ……然后什么?

lines.en: : You’re addicted to maid cafes, aren’t you?!
lines.zh: : 你沉迷女仆咖啡厅,对不对?!

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么?

lines.en: : I mean...I guess that would make sense given how much you like cute girls and stuff. But I didn’t think you’d be spending every waking moment there.
lines.zh: : 我是说……考虑到你有多喜欢可爱的女孩什么的,倒也说得通。但我没想到你醒着的每一秒都耗在那里。

lines.en: : I think there’s some sort of misunderstanding. I’ve only been there-
lines.zh: : 这里有误会。我只去过——

lines.en: : Wait...but if you spend every waking moment there...
lines.zh: : 等等……可如果你醒着的每一秒都在那里……

lines.en: : If I was hired at the maid cafe, I’d get to spend every waking moment with you!
lines.zh: : 要是我在女仆咖啡厅上班,那我醒着的每一秒不就都和你在一起了!

lines.en: : And I already know everything you like! So your service would be amazing and you’d be forced to give me all of your money!
lines.zh: : 而且我喜欢什么你全都知道!你的服务一定超棒,而且你不得不把所有钱都花在我身上!

lines.en: : I love this idea!
lines.zh: : 我爱这个主意!

lines.en: : I love it so much that I’m going to ignore your newly-discovered maid fetish!
lines.zh: : 我爱到可以无视你刚暴露的女仆癖!

lines.en: : I mean...I don't know if I'd call it a fetish...
lines.zh: : 呃……我倒不觉得那算癖好……

lines.en: : Any fetish you have is fine with me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你有什么癖好我都照单全收,Sensei。

lines.en: : I really don't like how nonchalantly you said that.
lines.zh: : 你说得那么云淡风轻,我反而不太舒服。

lines.en: : Would you want to come with me soon and see if they’re hiring or something?
lines.zh: : 那你愿意近期陪我去一趟,看看招不招人之类的吗?

lines.en: : I’d feel a lot more confident about applying if you’re there with me.
lines.zh: : 有你在身边,我面试会自信很多。

lines.en: : Aren’t you worried that I’m going to spend all of my money on the other maids while we’re there?
lines.zh: : 你不担心我到了那儿,把所有钱都花在其他女仆身上?

lines.en: : No. Because if you even talk to them, I will cut your fingers off and feed them to ducks.
lines.zh: : 不担心。因为你只要敢跟她们搭话,我就剁掉你的手指喂鸭子。

lines.en: : Joke's on you, ducks are primarily herbivores and probably wouldn’t even eat human fingers.
lines.zh: : 那你可输了,鸭子主要是草食动物,估计根本不吃人手指。

lines.en: : Joke's on you, I raised an army of carnivorous ducks and have been hiding them behind the dorms.
lines.zh: : 那你可输了,我养了一支肉食鸭军团,一直藏在宿舍后面。

lines.en: : They’re ready to eat your fingers at a moment’s notice.
lines.zh: : 它们随时待命,就等着吃你的手指。

lines.en: : I have several questions but I’m going to ignore them and replace them all with the thought of you calling me Master.
lines.zh: : 我有一堆问题,但我决定全部无视,用「你叫我 Master」这个念头取而代之。

lines.en: : That’s exactly what I’ve been calling you for a while now.
lines.zh: : 我不是已经叫了你很久了吗。

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you’re thinking of things like that in the middle of the mall...are you, Master?
lines.zh: : 别告诉我你在商场里就在想那种事……对吧,Master?

lines.en: : I plead the fifth. This conversation is supposed to be about you getting a job.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝回答。这番对话的主题应该是你找工作。

lines.en: : You know I’d be okay with calling you that regardless, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道吧,就算没有这一出,我也乐意那么叫你?

lines.en: : If that's really your end-goal, we can just skip the job part if you want~
lines.zh: : 如果那真是你的终极目标,那工作这一步我们也可以直接跳过哦~

lines.en: : If we skip that part, you’ll be unemployed forever.
lines.zh: : 跳过这步,你可就永远失业了。

lines.en: : What if I’m not good, though?
lines.zh: : 可我要是干不好呢?

lines.en: : I really only know how to take care of you, not other men.
lines.zh: : 我真的只会照顾你一个人,别的男人我不会。

lines.en: : There aren’t even that many men left in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 何况 Kumon-mi 也没剩下几个男人了。

lines.en: : If any of them hit on you, just...say you’re into girls and tell them to go away or something.
lines.zh: : 真有人来搭讪,你就……说自己是同性恋,让他们走开之类的。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that sort of thing would get me fired from a maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 我很确定,这种操作在女仆咖啡厅会被开除的。

lines.en: : Probably. But there’s always a chance they could just think that’s your archetype or something.
lines.zh: : 大概。但说不定人家只当那是你的人设设定呢。

lines.en: : Oh! You mean like a...tsundere maid?
lines.zh: : 哦!你是说那种……傲娇女仆?

lines.en: : Sure. Let's go with that.
lines.zh: : 对。就这么定了。

lines.en: : I-Idiot...It’s not like I even want to be a maid or anything...
lines.zh: : 笨、笨蛋……我又不是想当什么女仆……

lines.en: : See? You'll be just fine. You've already got the character down better than Yumi and she's been doing this for years.
lines.zh: : 看?你没问题的。你的人设掌握得比 Yumi 还好,她都干了好几年了。

lines.en: : You better not be implying that Yumi actually likes you or something, [amimaster]...
lines.zh: : 你最好不是在暗示 Yumi 真的喜欢你什么的,[amimaster]……

lines.en: : Of course not. Yumi doesn't like anyone. That's why I said you have the character down better than her.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。Yumi 谁都不喜欢。所以我才说你比她有人设。

lines.en: : Likely story...Now I have to add another name to my list.
lines.zh: : 鬼才信……好了,我的名单上又多了一个名字。

lines.en: : List? What list?
lines.zh: : 名单?什么名单?

lines.en: : Don't you worry about it, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你就别操心了,Sensei。

lines.en: : Don't you worry at all...
lines.zh: : 一点都不用操心……

lines.en: Ami and I walk around the mall for a little while longer as we go over other possible scenarios that might occur if she actually gets a job at a maid cafe.
lines.zh: Ami 和我在商场里又逛了一会儿,推演着她真去女仆咖啡厅上班后可能出现的各种情景。

lines.en: The one that sticks out in my head amongst the others, however, is that she could walk around the house wearing the costume.
lines.zh: 但在所有情景里,最让我念念不忘的是:她可以穿着那身女仆装在家里走来走去。

lines.en: Is this something a typical adult male should be excited about when concerning his [teenage][niece]? Probably not.
lines.zh: 一个正常的成年男性,该为这种事兴奋吗——对象还是他的 [teenage] [niece]?大概不该。

lines.en: But I am no typical adult male.
lines.zh: 但我不是正常的成年男性。

lines.en: Trading away my morals has allowed more space within me think about things others would not dare think of.
lines.zh: 出卖了道德之后,我心里腾出了更多空间,去想别人不敢想的事。

lines.en: And it’s that exact thought process that makes me go from worrying about a distinct lack of Ami around the house to eagerly awaiting her prospective future in the workforce...
lines.zh: 正是这套思维流程,让我从担心家里少见 Ami 的身影,变成翘首期盼她的职场新生活……

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
